# Bahulam Benchmarks

Public, versioned coding-agent benchmark results for [Bahulam Code](https://bahulam.ai) across multiple suites, models, and agent configurations.

**Hosted at:** [github.com/BahulamAI/bahulam-benchmarks](https://github.com/BahulamAI/bahulam-benchmarks)

**Every result in this repo is self-contained** — full predictions, official evaluator output, cost, and configuration are stored per run. Reproduce any number by re-running its `config.yaml` against the referenced `@bahulam/code` npm version.

## Suites

- [`swe-bench-lite`](suites/swe-bench-lite/) — 300-instance SWE-bench Lite from Princeton NLP
- [`swe-bench-verified`](suites/swe-bench-verified/) — 500 curated Verified instances
- [`swe-bench-full`](suites/swe-bench-full/) — full 2,294-instance SWE-bench
- [`terminal-bench`](suites/terminal-bench/) — Anthropic Terminal-bench Core
- [`humaneval`](suites/humaneval/) — OpenAI HumanEval / MBPP function-generation
- [`mbpp`](suites/mbpp/)

Each suite has a `runs/` directory. Each run directory is a complete artifact bundle.

## Run schema

Every run under `suites/<name>/runs/<run-id>/` contains:

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `config.yaml` | Harness version, model routing, prompts, timeouts, framework version |
| `predictions.json` | Model outputs per instance (SWE-bench-format for SWE suites) |
| `docker-eval.json` | Official evaluator's report (unmodified) |
| `summary.md` | Human-readable results, per-instance table, notes on failure modes |
| `costs.json` | Real gateway spend, tokens in/out, cache hit rate, wall-clock |
| `logs/` | Optional per-instance logs (gzipped) |

## Adding a new run

1. `scripts/new-run.sh <suite> <run-slug>` — scaffolds an empty run dir with `config.yaml` template
2. Populate `config.yaml`, execute the run against the referenced harness
3. Drop `predictions.json` + `docker-eval.json` into the dir
4. Write `summary.md` (see any existing run for the format)
5. Run `scripts/generate-readme.py` to regenerate the top-level table
6. Commit + push — CI validates the manifest and re-runs the README generator

## Reproducibility promise

Every result here is reproducible with the referenced runtime version (`@bahulam/code@<x.y.z>`), same env vars, and public dataset (`princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Lite` etc.). Gateway auth requires a Bahulam API key from [bahulam.ai](https://bahulam.ai); model providers are pinned by version to avoid drift.
